D1.topic: BASS material cell with two unlabeled dimensions
D1.rationale: Clear from context that the cm value is the width and the mm/micron value the thickness. Accept as proposed, keeping a visible note that the assignment was assumed from context.

D2.topic: BASS material cell with one unlabeled dimension
D2.rationale: Must not be thickness. The single dimension is unclear, so leave it unassigned: keep it as an additional field with a note giving the stated dimension and saying it is unclear what it corresponds to. Do not force it into any field.

D3.topic: BASS rod samples with inch dimensions
D3.rationale: Do not infer PMMA where the source names no material. The rod dimension cannot be placed in the existing fields, so keep it as an additional field with a note on its ambiguity (probably diameter, not stated).

D4.topic: BASS material cell with labeled dimensions
D4.rationale: Accept the proposals. Where the cm value is unlabeled, the D1 context rule applies, with the same note.

D5.rationale: Accept, interpretation unresolved: gravity level of the '?-g' columns and the mm/s 'Spread Length' unit stay flagged.

D6.topic: BASS CO readings with marker OR
D6.rationale: Keep 'OR' (and 'over') as written. Note that it likely signifies over/out of range, without assuming it.

D7.rationale: 037 mm: keep as written with a note that it is likely 0.37 mm, inferred by us. 'See Fig. 5': pending, reviewer to check the figure.

D8.topic: Geometry 'film' added by the importer's rule-based parser (B11, B15)
D8.rationale: Accept: keep geometry 'film' added by the importer, with a note that the parser (not the model) supplied it from the literal word in the cell.
